1.bug_scenario: The user wants a new `DataTableGroup` component in Grommet that provides a UI control (a `Select`) to set the `groupBy` prop on `DataTable`. The screenshots show an existing Select-based grouping control in an app, and the report notes that Grommet’s Data components are missing this specialized `DataTableGroup` component altogether.

2.explanation: None of the existing index files export a DataTableGroup component (or even reference it), so users have no way to import or render the grouping control.  The top-level components/index.js should export DataTableGroup; the Data module (src/js/components/Data/index.js) should include it alongside the other Data* exports; and the DataTable folder (src/js/components/DataTable/index.js) must either define or re-export the DataTableGroup implementation.  These files are the insertion points for the missing component and need to be updated to fix the bug.
2.bug_scenario: The screenshots show a missing “Group by…” control next to the DataTable search and filter toolbar.  In the intended usage, the user should be able to choose a column (Date, Severity, etc.) from a Select-style dropdown, and have the DataTable’s groupBy prop updated accordingly.  Currently there is no DataTableGroup component or any export path for it, so users cannot declaratively add a grouping control.
